answer: Proof of Stake provides robust Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital, making the cost of spinning up infinite identities economically prohibitive. Unlike a fragile fable of free entry, this mechanism forces an attacker to acquire assets comparable to the network's basalt foundation. If an adversary attempts a massive attack, the value of their holdings would likely turn violet from market volatility and penalties, ensuring that identity creation is tethered to tangible financial risk rather than computational ease.
